description: Medium-Voltage Distribution (Predictive) is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Energy access, Power system and utilities", published or maintained by Dimitry Gershenson; Brandon Rohrer; Anna Lerner (Facebook). Facebook has produced a model to help map global medium voltage (MV) grid infrastructure, i.e. the distribution lines which connect high-voltage transmission infrastructure to consumer-serving low-voltage distribution. The data found here are model outputs for six select African countries: Malawi, Nigeria, Uganda, DRC, Cote D’Ivoire, and Zambia. Coverage: 6 countries in Sub-Saharan Africa. It has 12 files in GeoTIFF, CSV. The portal files it under Energy access, Power system and utilities, Transmission and distribution. The portal gives 2019 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
